description: Execute ExtendScript (JSX) inside Illustrator and return the result. Runs as a function body: end with `return <value>`. ES3 only. Key DOM: app.documents, activeDocument, artboards, layers, pathItems (setEntirePath), textFrames, groupItems, symbols. Colors via new RGBColor(). GOTCHAS: exports/previews act on the ACTIVE document — activate by name first; documents.add() switches the active doc; no blend API (interpolate shapes in a loop); artboardRect is [0, H, W, 0] with Y up. More: knowledge_search.
name: ai_run_extendscript
title: Run ExtendScript in Illustrator
